meta.title: POC - Full Name is marked required

steps.note: Open the prepared event's Participants screen as the buyer so the Invite Vendor drawer can be reached.

args.goal: open the Invite Vendor side drawer, verify that the POC - Full Name field is marked required with an asterisk, leave it empty, click Next, and stop with the drawer showing that Next did not proceed

steps.note: Perform the drawer interaction and inspect the required marker, which no dedicated catalog step can express.
Assert that the empty required field is rejected when Next is clicked.
